mapper.insert: insert into foster_record(order_id, staff_id, room_id, check_in_time, check_out_time, daily_log, food_preference, notes, create_time, update_time) values (#{orderId}, #{staffId}, #{roomId}, #{checkInTime}, #{checkOutTime}, #{dailyLog}, #{foodPreference}, #{notes}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select:
SELECT fr.id, fr.order_id, fr.staff_id, fr.room_id, fr.check_in_time as checkInTime, fr.check_out_time as checkOutTime, fr.daily_log as dailyLog, fr.food_preference as foodPreference, fr.notes, fr.create_time as createTime, fr.update_time as updateTime, r.room_number as roomNumber, r.room_type as roomType, su.id as employeeID, su.real_name as employeeRealName, su.role as employeeRole
FROM foster_record fr LEFT JOIN rooms r ON fr.room_id = r.room_id LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON fr.staff_id = su.id WHERE fr.order_id = #{orderId}
